text:
Sebastian once spearheaded a critical data pipeline overhaul at NeonPixel, merging real-time analytics from Kafka with batch processing via Spark. He architected a Snowflake-based warehouse that cut query latency by 40% during peak hours, while AWS infrastructure scaling under his design handled a 3x traffic surge without downtime. His Airflow workflows automated 90% of ETL tasks, slashing manual intervention and errors. When a game update caused data schema chaos, he rebuilt the pipeline in 12 hours using Terraform, ensuring zero data loss.  

We’ve collaborated daily for over two years, debugging production issues and refining workflows. Sebastian’s Python expertise isn’t just technical—he’s the go-to for refactoring legacy code into scalable, maintainable systems. His mentorship helped junior engineers adopt best practices, and his attention to detail ensures even edge cases are addressed.  

Sebastian’s strengths lie in his ability to balance complexity with clarity. He owns AWS costs meticulously, optimizing spot instances and reserved capacity to save the team $20k annually. His Kafka streams handle 10M+ events daily, and his Snowflake models power real-time dashboards for 15+ stakeholders. Beyond skills, he’s relentlessly reliable—always first in the office, staying late to resolve issues others avoid.  

In short, Sebastian is a linchpin of our data ops. His technical rigor and collaborative mindset make him indispensable. I’d wholeheartedly recommend him for any role requiring both depth and leadership.  

— [Your Name]  
Senior Data Engineer, NeonPixel Games
